title: Comprehensive assessment of disordered linker predictions using data from the third critical assessment of protein intrinsic disorder.
authors: Zhao, Bi; Yu, Jing; Kurgan, Lukasz
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文基于CAID3数据系统评估九种无序柔性连接子（DFL）预测器，聚焦蛋白质内在无序区域的结构预测问题，虽为方法评估而非新方法开发，但涉及深度学习与蛋白语言模型，对蛋白质结构计算研究有参考价值。
abstract: Disordered flexible linkers (DFLs) are an abundant type of intrinsically disordered regions that contribute to many cellular functions by facilitating movement between adjacent functional domains. Several new sequence-based predictors of DFL regions have been published in recent years, prompting the need to evaluate their predictive performance comparatively. We used the recently released data from the third Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder prediction (CAID3) to comprehensively evaluate nine DFL predictors, including seven methods that participated in CAID3 and two additional, recently published DFL predictors. We expanded the CAID3 evaluation by examining predictions on a larger dataset and, arguably, more practical test scenarios that assess predictions at the residue, region, and protein levels. We also evaluated on a subset of CAID3 proteins that share less than 30% sequence similarity with the training sets of the included DFL predictors, yielding more robust estimates of predictive performance. We showed that several DFL predictors accurately identify DFL residues among other types of disordered residues. We also found that different methods perform better in different scenarios, with several methods producing very accurate predictions of DFL residues and a few performing well when predicting proteins with DFLs. While our results suggest that progress has been made in recent years, driven by the use of deep learning and protein language models, we also identified a major weakness in current tools, as they are unable to reproduce the correct sizes and numbers of DFL regions. We also suggested several ways to develop new DFL predictors that would address this issue.
abstract_zh: 无序柔性连接子（DFLs）是一类丰富的内在无序区域，通过促进相邻功能域之间的运动，参与多种细胞功能。近年来，已发表了几种基于序列的DFL区域预测器，因此有必要对其预测性能进行比较评估。我们利用第三次蛋白质内在无序预测关键评估（CAID3）最近发布的数据，全面评估了九种DFL预测器，包括七种参与CAID3的方法以及两种额外、近期发表的DFL预测器。我们扩展了CAID3的评估，在更大的数据集上检查预测，并采用了更具实际意义的测试场景，在残基、区域和蛋白质水平上评估预测。我们还对CAID3蛋白质的一个子集进行了评估，这些蛋白质与所包含的DFL预测器的训练集共享的序列相似性低于30%，从而获得了更稳健的预测性能估计。我们表明，几种DFL预测器能准确识别其他类型无序残基中的DFL残基。我们还发现，不同方法在不同场景下表现更优，其中几种方法对DFL残基的预测非常准确，少数方法在预测含有DFL的蛋白质时表现良好。尽管我们的结果表明，近年来在深度学习和蛋白质语言模型的使用推动下取得了进展，但我们也识别出当前工具的一个主要弱点，即它们无法重现DFL区域的正确大小和数量。我们还提出了几种开发新DFL预测器的方法，以解决这一问题。
